tool_args.rationale: The pilot supports a smooth monotone-concave response, but narrow coverage with nearly fixed s_grad leaves meaningful ambiguity between saturating and power-law mechanisms. Since forecast horizon matches the pilot and the open-branch probe costs least, acquire it before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Not rejected; this is the lowest-cost probe that can distinguish plausible smooth response families beyond the narrow pilot range.
Higher cost and unnecessary before testing the competing model branches.
Irrelevant to the observed monotone-concave response and explicitly not worth purchasing.
Five observations across u_now at nearly fixed s_grad do not robustly identify the response family or its extrapolation.
